label: L-03
severityDecision: CONFIRMED-LOW (both legs weighed separately; leg (b) re-argued on its own merits)
severityRationale:
Low CONFIRMED for both legs, weighed independently rather than as one blended record.

LEG (a) - the false 'NOT paused' claim - is a FALSE-RATIONALE finding, explicitly NOT a stranded-value finding. The fork disproves the claim (paused() == true @25949772), but totalStaked() == 0 and phUSD/USDC balanceOf are both zero, so no value is stranded and none can be. The defect is that an irreversible edit (deleting a live mainnet contract's address-book key) and a repeated in-source assertion (AddressLoader.sol:86-92) both rest on a factual claim about mainnet that was never checked and is false. This classifier confirmed the substance directly: PhlimboV2.withdraw is whenNotPaused and the mainnet script itself says so in terms - DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:1829 require()s !v2.paused() before the migration, with a failure string explaining that a paused V2 yields a pass that completes with every user SKIPPED. So the comment does not merely misstate a status flag; it asserts a SAFETY PROPERTY - that a late staker can still exit - which is false. Zero stake makes it harmless today, which caps it at Low; it also gives a clean REOPEN TRIGGER (below) rather than a permanent dismissal.

LEG (b) - the hard-coded 604800 - argued on its own merits as directed, NOT as an address-book issue. It is a FIDELITY DIVERGENCE IN THE MIRROR: the local rehearsal runs a 7-day depletion window against mainnet's 30-day (4.29x faster), so any time-dependent depletion behaviour rehearsed locally - rate, accrual over the window, anything the Linear-Depletion family cares about - is unrepresentative of production, and the divergence is UNDOCUMENTED and self-justified by a false claim ('the ones V2 carried and V3 inherited at the mainnet cutover'; mainnet V2 and V3 both read 2592000). The project already has the right idiom for a deliberate local divergence - LOCAL_STREAM_DURATION and LOCAL_PROMO_DURATION are named and reasoned - and this literal does not use it.

WHY LEG (b) IS NOT MEDIUM. This classifier read the mainnet path directly: Phase 4e constructs PhlimboV3 with depletionDuration read LIVE off V2 (DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:1746, `uint256 v2Duration = v2.depletionDuration();` then `new PhlimboV3(PHUSD, v2Reward, v2Duration)` with a `v2Duration > 0` guard). There is NO mainnet consumer of the 604800 literal - it cannot propagate to production. Its whole effect is confined to how faithfully the local mirror represents mainnet timing. That is assurance quality, not protocol function or availability, so Low. It is nevertheless the only leg with ONGOING effect, and the run's clearest instance of the mirror silently ceasing to mirror.

ANCHOR MISMATCH - ESCALATION ENDORSED AND MADE BINDING. The record anchors server/deployments/mainnet-addresses.ts but leg (b) lives in script/DeployMocks.s.sol:2258-2263. This classifier does NOT re-anchor (re-minting a fingerprint is a finding-manager / human call). Under Law 1 the recall-safer option is a SPLIT, and this classifier RECOMMENDS it: if triage is likely to fix only the anchored file, leg (b) - the only leg that still does anything - is exactly what gets lost. Whatever anchoring is chosen, leg (b) MUST survive.
